changelog: Fixes registration with the File Transformation plugin, which had been failing on every startup: the plugin shipped its own copy of Newtonsoft.Json, so the payload it built was a different type than the one File Transformation expected, despite the identical name. The payload is now built through that plugin's own type and the duplicate library is no longer shipped at all. Script injection previously fell back to request-time middleware, which kept working, so this only restores the preferred path.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
